An '''ice pick''' was a device used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to break [[Water/Legends|ice]]. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] made use of such a tool during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].
